opening.quote: Agent: Good afternoon, Tidewell Home, you're speaking with Joost. How can I help?
opening.comment: You gave your name and the company name in the first turn, which meets the opening standard.

verification.quote: Agent: Okay. What's you know the order number?
verification.comment: You asked only for the order number and never confirmed the caller's full name or postcode before sharing the delivery address and order details, so verification was skipped.

understanding.quote: Customer: Hi, my lamp arrived with the glass shade cracked. I'm really upset, it was a birthday present.
understanding.comment: You captured the issue of a cracked lamp shade correctly and did not ask for details the caller had already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Agent: A free replacement lamp is on its way and arrives in 2 to 4 working days. The lamp was €39.95, so please send the damaged one back with the free return label I'm emailing you now.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The replacement timeline and free return label are correct for a EUR 39.95 item, which is at or above EUR 25 and so must be returned; the address and photo steps were handled as policy requires.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: Can your email us a photo of the cracked shade first?
process_compliance.comment: You correctly asked for a photo before arranging the replacement and emailed a free return label for an item of EUR 25 or more, but you never asked permission before any hold, so the check was not fully met; no hold occurred, so this step was not required.

communication.quote: Customer: Hi, my lamp arrived with the glass shade cracked. I'm really upset, it was a birthday present.
communication.comment: The caller said they were upset and you never acknowledged it, so you should have responded with empathy such as saying you're sorry about the damage to their birthday present.

closing.quote: Agent: You'll get the tracking link by email tomorrow. Anything else I can help with today?
closing.comment: You confirmed the next steps and asked if there was anything else, then closed politely, which meets the closing standard.
